#!/nix/store/nnm9gdr70ihc6zc9298mzz8jpcgaciql-bash-5.3p20/bin/bash

yarnJs="$(realpath ./.yarn/releases/yarn-4.18.1.cjs)"
yarn() {
  /nix/store/j1j9b0w3mhpccdli73ycj5w7nf6fkzqz-nodejs-24.21.0/bin/node "$yarnJs" "$@"
}
export BERRY_PURIFIER_INPUT_VIEWS='[]'


patchInstalled() {
  local dirs=()
  while IFS= read -r -d "" dir; do
    dirs+=("$dir")
  done < <(find . \( -name node_modules -o -path ./.yarn/unplugged \) -type d -prune -print0)
  if [ ${#dirs[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    patchShebangs "${dirs[@]}" > /dev/null
    if declare -F autoPatchelf > /dev/null; then
      autoPatchelf "${dirs[@]}"
    fi
  fi
}

patchInstalled
yarn install --immutable
runScript() {
  if true && node -e 'var scripts = require("./package.json").scripts; process.exit(scripts && scripts[process.argv[1]] ? 0 : 1)' "$1"; then
    yarn run "$1"
  else
    
    :
  fi
}

for script in build; do
  runScript "$script"
done
runHook postBuild

yarn  pack --out "$out"/prettier.tgz
